# Sample files for OHIF Viewer

## staticwebapp.config.json

Used by the **Azure Static Web Apps** workflow (`.github/workflows/azure-static-web-apps.yml`).

- The workflow copies **this file** into `platform/app/dist/` before running `swa deploy`.
- Edit `staticwebapp.config.json` in this folder to change Azure Static Web Apps behavior.

See [Azure Static Web Apps configuration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/static-web-apps/configuration) for more options.
